title: IGNORE takes an expression out of the test that drops blank rows

source.quote: Rows for which all expressions not using IGNORE return BLANK/NULL will be excluded independent of whether the expressions which do use IGNORE evaluate to BLANK/NULL or not.
source.supports: the page has the same pattern: a total under IGNORE and an IF that is blank for some groups

derivation: Quantity by country: US (Ann, Bob) rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 = 1 + 2 + 1 + 5 + 1 = 10; JP (Cho) rows 5, 6 = 2 + 3 = 5; FR none. Big is 1 only for US. JP has Qty 5 but its only expression outside IGNORE is BLANK, so the row is dropped; without IGNORE it would be returned as JP, 5, BLANK.
